description: Bootstrap carousel.js v3.2.0 implementation defining the Carousel class and related plugin API, handling carousel behavior such as cycling, sliding, and event triggering.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: Class implementing carousel functionality including cycling, sliding, and event handling.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Handles keydown events for carousel navigation.

methods.name: cycle
methods.description: Starts or stops automatic cycling of the carousel.

methods.name: getItemIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a given item within the carousel.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Navigates to a specific slide index.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous slide.

methods.name: slide
methods.description: Performs the slide transition to the next or previous item.
